display.summary: Incremental backups, the PDF toolkit, permission visibility filters and a translation audit.
highlights: Backups: incremental chains, encryption choice, snapshot-consistent PostgreSQL reads, cancel, and a backup before every update or rollback (manage.py dlux_backup).
Optional PDF viewer and modal page editor (django-lux[pdf]); Entry Clipboard snippets for entry forms.
register_permission_visibility_filter() and manage.py dlux_translations for projects.
Upgrading from 1.10.x needs a project image rebuild (floor 1.11.0b7); additive migrations only.
